Lina (Support): Escalating to CS — customer RidgePath trial blocked on SSO provisioning, ticket #18234 shows 403s and quota messages after a large dataset ingest. Renewal window ~30 days. Need priority outreach.
Omar (CS): Copy. Do we have account tier and any committed ARR?
Lina (Support): Trial, no ARR. Error body: {\"error\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"code\":403}. Link to logs in ticket.
Priya (SE): Common pattern: heavy embed batch caused quota enforcement and prov flow failed during API key rotation. Immediate mitigation: short quota bump (24-72h) + suggest smaller batch sizes; capture full request/response for engineering.
Omar (CS): Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate proactive outreach admitting impact and next steps, 2) Offer 48h quota bump and temporary workaround, 3) 30m troubleshooting call with SE, 4) Capture onboarding friction for docs. Owner: Hector will lead customer touch.
Hector (CS Manager): Ill take the outreach. @Sam (AE) add any commercial notes for the email. Ill draft message and propose timeline.
Sam (AE): Include a brief reassurance about pilot completion and next steps for renewal. Tone: proactive, empathetic.
Lina (Support): Updated ticket: "Escalated to CS. Applied +750 quota units for 48h. Point of contact: Hector." Also adding the curl they used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{\"tenant\":\"ridgepath\"}'`
Omar (CS): Ill prepare a short email draft and post here for review in 15m. Subject idea: "Redwood: Immediate SSO help + trial access update".
Hector (CS Manager): Scheduling call: 2024-04-01 15:30 PST (30m). Invites sent to RidgePath, SE, and support. Action items: (A) Hector: send email & outreach, (B) Priya: confirm quota bump and triage logs, (C) Docs: add runbook note on SSO + quota, (D) CS: flag renewal risk in CRM.
Priya (SE): Ill collect request logs and check for key rotation timing. If still failing after bump, escalate to eng oncall.
Omar (CS): After call well make a 48h follow-up plan and capture customer feedback for onboarding improvements.
Lina (Support): Leaving final ticket note: "Customer unblocked? pending call. If not, escalate to engineering oncall."
Hector (CS Manager): Thanks team. Ill post the customer-facing email draft shortly and log a 48h postmortem plan.
-- end thread --
